newsitem.title: HONG KONG: COSCO HK in talks to sell 7-floors of Cosco Tower.
newsitem.headline: COSCO HK in talks to sell 7-floors of Cosco Tower.

text.p: China-owned shipping conglomerate COSCO (Hong Kong) Group Ltd is in talks to sell seven of the 15 floors it owns in Cosco Tower in Hong Kong's Sheung Wan district, vice president Song Dawei said on Thursday.

"The offices were bought for self use, but now after some of our companies are brought together, there will be spare space," Song said, adding the company will retain the top eight floors for its own use.

COSCO (Hong Kong), the parent of COSCO Pacific Ltd, was negotiating with buyers although there was no schedule for the sale yet, and the company would use the expected proceeds to repay bank borrowings, Song said.
COSCO (Hong Kong) planned to move in to the tower, which will become the group's new headquarter, in June after construction is completed in March or April, he added.
Property analysts estimated COSCO (Hong Kong) could net more than HK$1.26 billion from the sale at a market price of above HK$10,000 a square feet.

The group bought the top 15 floors of the office tower in May for HK$2.9-3.0 billion from a joint venture between New World Development Ltd and the quasi-governmental Land Development Corp. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6369
